topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 41 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 9 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 23 common project-authored base contract(s) (aoperator, feem, initializegovernedupgradeabilityproxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
